Question: What can be inferred from kaustubh's experience in user experience (UX) design based on his faculty affiliation with Prof. Ruchi K at NMIMS?

Answer: Based on the information provided, it is likely that Kaustubh has learned and studied UX principles under the guidance of a reputable professional like Prof. Ruchi K from National Institute of Management Studies & Research (NMIMS). This affiliation suggests he could have access to quality education in user experience design which includes elements such as usability, functionality, interaction flows etc., all aimed at improving product and service experiences for users.

Cloud Computing refers to a collection of network-accessible IT resources, consisting of shared hardware and software pools deployed in data centers. It enables consumers to hire these resources as services without direct management effort or service provider interaction, supporting ubiquitous access on demand with minimal administrative tasks involved.

A hypervisor, also known as virtual machine monitor or Virtual Machine Monitor (VMM), is software that creates and runs virtual machines by abstracting the physical hardware resources of a host system. It separates these into multiple isolated environments called VMs where each VM can run its own operating system independently on top of this abstraction layer provided by hypervisor technology, effectively sharing CPU time among them as needed.
